enabled.label: Count typing
enabled.description: Count printable keys while the plugin is loaded.

block_size.label: Characters per block
block_size.description: How many characters make the counter advance by one (100 by default).

thresholds.label: Heatmap thresholds
thresholds.description: Four comma-separated daily character counts for levels 1, 2, 3 and 4. Below the first value is level 0. Default 500,1000,2000,5000.

level_notify.label: Notify on a new level
level_notify.description: Send a notification when today's typing reaches a new heatmap level.

filter_mode.label: Window filter
filter_mode.description: Count only certain windows (whitelist) or skip certain windows (blacklist), using the niri app_id of the focused window.

filter_apps.label: Filter app IDs
filter_apps.description: One niri app_id per entry, case-insensitive (for example Alacritty, wechat, firefox). An empty whitelist counts nothing; an empty blacklist counts everything.

reset.title: Typing stats reset
reset.body: The character counter is back to 0.

no_access.title: Typing Stats needs input access
no_access.body: Run setup.sh in the plugin directory once to install the udev rule, then reload the plugin.
